content: Related work. In tag recommender systems, mostly content-based algorithms (e.g., BIBREF4 , BIBREF5 ) are used to recommend tags to annotate resources such as e-books. In our work, we incorporate both content features of e-books (i.e., title and description text) as well as Amazon search terms to account for the vocabulary of e-book readers.
